$comment: ARC-87 normalizePath vectors. Writers SHOULD emit the canonical `[N]` index form; readers MUST also accept the dotted `.N` form. normalizePath maps every `[N]` to `.N` outside of `${...}` escaped spans so that both spellings resolve to the same slot. Each case lists the equivalence class `inputs` and the single `normalized` form they all map to. normalizePath MUST be idempotent: normalizePath(normalized) === normalized.

cases.name: spec: blobs[1] and blobs.1 are the same slot
index outside an escaped span is still normalized
escaped span containing a dotted index is left untouched
unprefixed paths normalize the same way
